spatial_context.note: Full 11QC dimer with bound crop graft used ONLY for accessibility; observed glycans and 10A anchor/cut buffers are incomplete glycan coverage. Native-contact positions are exempt from low-total-SASA exclusion alone, never from crop/glycan/excess-exposure exclusions.

screen.replicates: ONE seed/sample; screening only, not a qualified parent
screen.controls: 2DS25.5 selected model must recover fold<=2A, native-contact recall>=0.5, interface pose<=2A, ipTM>=0.5 in both seeds; presumed negatives must not reach 0.5 interface ipTM in selected models
screen.families: Exploratory complete-link clustering: >=30% identity OR equal-length self-fit CA RMSD<=3A joins a family; inspect before any expansion
screen.decision: One 100-design batch; at most six distinct full-screen passes enter frozen confirmation. No automatic expansion.
screen.limits: Self-consistency is not binding validation. Low-score exclusions are not demonstrated nonbinders. No affinity or pH claims. Mouse compatibility remains untested.
screen.ranking: Within binder class: geometry eligibility first, then equal-weight percentile ranks of interface ipTM descending, contact-pair PAE ascending, hotspot fraction descending, binder fold RMSD ascending. Sequence diversity selection at 80% identity; preserve epitope representation.
screen.nanobody_confidence: Record ipTM>=0.5 as descriptive only; no validated positive VHH control on this target.
screen.control_policy: One-sample matched 2DS25.5 plus presumed negatives; fail blocks advancement, does not trigger automatic reruns.

selection_rule.alignment: Rigid least-squares fit using all 194 corresponding target C-alpha atoms; no binder atoms
selection_rule.completeness: Exact target sequence and all 194 finite target CA coordinates required
selection_rule.ranking: Among eligible samples, maximize 0.8*ipTM + 0.2*pTM; tie -> lowest sample index
selection_rule.no_eligible_samples: Case fails; no fallback to a rejected sample
selection_rule.scope: Identical rule for positive, negative and novel cases; no binder geometry or epitope used for selection
selection_rule.rationale: Target distortion made global-frame pose validation unreliable in a previous control. The 2 A scale matches the existing structural-screen tolerance; this is a new heuristic, not a validated physical boundary.

structural_preparation.interpretation: Uniform post-hoc sensitivity analysis, specified before revised outcomes; never replaces raw or v1 decisions.
structural_preparation.method: Amber14/GBn2, 12 A cutoff, both backbones restrained; all side chains and hydrogens mobile
structural_preparation.protonation: Strip explicit H; PROPKA assigns H consistently to free and bound forms of the same prepared conformation. Any incomplete/protonation-failed group invalidates that calculation.
structural_preparation.cohort: Every confidence-selected final His panel candidate and control, including failures.
structural_preparation.policy: One preparation per source; no selective retries; source sequence and original atom identities preserved; raw screen failures cannot be rescued. Original pose/contact/context gates and pKa heuristics unchanged.
limitations: No unbound ensemble or full proton linkage
Finite minimization is not proof of convergence or global stereochemical validity

prospective_plan.site_policy: Neutral peripheral sites in both parent poses; preserve charged residues, high-contact anchors and five terminal residues. Up to twelve singles and two pairs; pairs include a site with basic neighbours in both poses, CA spacing 5-16 A. Geometry is a hypothesis, not interaction energy.
prospective_plan.selection: Unchanged target-integrity-aware confidence selection. Both selected models and all selected controls must pass; no alternative-sample rescue or seed retries.
prospective_plan.direction: Unchanged v2 preparation of ALL selected models. Direction requires raw pass, matched parent pass, preparation movement/internal geometry and prepared screen pass, valid PROPKA groups; each introduced His shift <= -0.5, at least one free pKa 6-7, His-only ratio >=2, artificial target termini >=10 A, consistently in both poses. Full qualification additionally requires all six prepared control models and both matched-parent prepared models to pass the same preparation checks.
prospective_plan.tag_followup: At most two two-pose direction passes, ranked by worst-pose His-only ratio descending then worst-pose ipTM descending then ID. Matched bare/tagged parent and variants, plus all three controls; fresh seeds 2707/2801. No qualifying variant means no tag job.
prospective_plan.stop: One panel and at most one conditional tag job; freeze submission afterwards. No broad generation.
